Following the execution path, we find that the code does not raise any error when attempting to assign a non-integer value ("a") to an integer-typed array. Consequently, the assertion within the `with pytest.raises` block fails, leading to the error demonstrated by the test.

To fix this issue, you should ensure that the method handling the item assignment correctly checks if the value being assigned is of the expected type (in this case, an integer) and raises a `ValueError` if it is not. This can be done by adding a type check within the assignment logic.

```
